title: A/R Collection: changing the Past due filter keeps the sort
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has overdue invoices on today's date, some 1 to 30 days and some 31 to 60 days past due.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-35 Past Due Sort.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Collection is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Open balance" header once.
  2. In the Past due filter, tick "31-60 days".
  3. Expand {Customer-A}'s group.
  4. Look at the "Open balance" header.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: rows sort by Open balance, largest first.
  • Step 2: the report reloads with only 31 to 60 day invoices (and credits) left.
  • Step 3: the rows in the group are still sorted by Open balance, largest first.
  • Step 4: "Open balance" is still marked as the sorted column.

Held for the PO: the PRD lists the as-of date, paging and the customer, vendor and Location filters as keeping the sort, but not the Past due filter; the story's acceptance criteria include it. Question 6 asks Chris Ward.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S2-R7: “The sort is kept while the user stays on the report: changing the as-of date, paging, and changing the customer, vendor or Location filter keep it.”
  • S5-R16: “With ranges ticked, A/R Detail, A/R Collection, A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices keep only the invoices and bills whose days past due on the as-of date fall in a ticked range, and always keep credit memos, deposits and vendor credits.”
